Each slot has its own BC/N/ORM set instead of one shared atlas; manifest 'materials' entries need per-slot texture paths. Hair: alpha_mask/masked/two_sided true (alpha is in BC). Gear uses ORM.B metallic (brass and iron buckles). Skin: subsurface on; T_Dink_PR_Skin_SSS.png (rgb scatter colour x thickness) is extra and optional.
Normal maps are OpenGL (+Y) like the existing sets: keep normal_flip_green true.

Skeleton unchanged: 89 bones, same names/hierarchy/rest pose as HandBindingV2; hand and head skin weights are the shipped ones; garments take weights by surface transfer from the shipped hero. Existing clips (MM idle/walk, A_Dink_Fist) apply unchanged.
A Physics Asset still has to be generated in Unreal as for the existing hero.

Brows and lashes are alpha cards inside the MI_Dink_PR_Hair slot (bottom quarter of T_Dink_PR_Hair_BC): the slot must be masked/two-sided or they render as solid quads; there is no separate BrowLash slot any more.
Hair cards: UV V runs along the strands (root at the top of each strip), so an anisotropic/hair shading model should take its tangent from V. Roughness is in ORM.G; keep specular low.

UV uniqueness is per slot (see uv_per_slot): Skin 0 %, Outfit 1.7 %, Gear 0.9 % overlap (thickness lips share their border texels); Hair cards share strand strips and both eyes share one texture by design. The validator's whole-mesh UV_OVERLAP error is expected with five texture sets.

known_weaknesses: Not photoreal at 1 m. Round 2 rebuilt the hair (undercoat cap + five card layers, soft hairline wisps), firmed brow/jaw/chin, added lip colour and stubble shadow, shrank and darkened the iris; it now reads as a young man in sun and overcast, but: freckles are heavy and the cheek still shows faint pore scaling, lower-lid/tear-line detail and caruncle are texture only, no teeth (no jaw bone), round 7 flattened the crown cards and thinned the flyaways: two or three edge-on slivers still show at the crown silhouette in the overcast close-up.
Proportions: garments were slimmed 2 mm; shoulders, neck length, hands and feet are set by the shared 89-bone rig and the shipped head/hand skin, so he is not visibly lankier.

Shirt collar notch is still ragged; round 7 culls and tucks the neck skin under the collar so skin no longer shows through it in the overcast close-up (r7_overcast), but the torn-looking notch remains; jerkin hem has stretched texels.
Folds are authored displacement fields; periodic ripple was reduced and directional folds strengthened, some regularity remains on the sleeves.

Armhole: the shirt body continues under the jerkin so raised arms show cloth; round 7 raised garment weight smoothing from 3 to 8 passes and the reach pose (r7_poses, fifth pose) still pinches at the armpit just as before: not fixed, it needs corrective shapes or a re-cut armhole.
LOD3 rebuilt at 10.7k triangles (was 6.4k) to keep the face and hem; LODs checked in one Blender render only.
